submission.justification: Recommend Algorithm-L3 with a 38 GeV threshold. In the fine threshold scan, this point gives the highest recorded signal efficiency among all deployable candidate algorithms and allowed thresholds: 93.386%, exceeding the next-best valid option, Algorithm-L1 at 39 GeV with 86.198%, by 7.188 percentage points. The threshold is within the required 20–60 GeV range and the algorithm is marked deployable in Level-1 hardware.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: The recorded optimization selects Algorithm-L3 at 38 GeV as the best fine overall point with efficiency 93.386%; the next-best valid point is Algorithm-L1 at 39 GeV with 86.198%, giving a 7.188 percentage-point margin. The scan was performed for the allocated Level-1 rate of 8 kHz.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Selected Algorithm-L3, one of the three allowed candidates; num_allowed_candidates = 3 and final_recommended_algorithm_index = 3.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware.

requirements.evidence: Recommended threshold is 38 GeV, which lies within the allowed range 20–60 GeV.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended algorithm and threshold.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Algorithm-L3 at 38 GeV.
